name: Drift Lindström-Esquivel-Vasquez-Alfarsi
location: The Circuit, near Damen and Armitage
related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian dominant (45.4%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (21.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (21.1%), and Middle Eastern (7.6%) ancestry; minor East Asian and North African heritage. A truly global genetic blend reflected in warm golden-brown undertones, high cheekbones with defined structure, and warm-hued eye coloring.
physical_description.build: Lean and efficient, shoulders squared from years of moving through crowds and confrontations. No wasted mass — functional muscle in forearms and legs.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with intentional silver threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid that wraps around the crown; allows full peripheral vision
physical_description.eye_color: Warm dark brown with amber undertones, alert and constantly scanning
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown complexion; sun-weathered texture. Rich undertones from Southeast Asian and African ancestry with warm accents from Latin American heritage. Deeper in sun-exposed areas, luminous where protected.
physical_description.complexion: High, defined cheekbones with gentle width across face reflecting Southeast Asian structure; strong jaw with subtle softness from African heritage. Minimal makeup — practical grooming. A faint scar runs through her left eyebrow, giving her resting expression an intensity that isn't entirely accidental. Warm undertones visible especially around cheeks and temples.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar through left eyebrow, approximately 3cm, pale and old — source unknown
Tattooed circuit pattern on inner left wrist in black ink: interconnected nodes forming a simplified map of The Circuit's main streets
Burn scar on right shoulder blade, roughly 5cm diameter, pale and years old — accident or incident never mentioned
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal LED grid beneath translucent patches of skin on both temples (faint blue-green glow when active, used for heads-up data display). Left ear has a visible jack port behind the lobe, roughly 8mm, chromed steel. No other obvious augmentations.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and alert. Walks with purpose, rarely fidgets. Leans against walls or furniture in social situations rather than sitting — maintains sight lines. Speaks with measured deliberation; people instinctively listen. Her gaze lands on faces and holds them.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatic: fitted charcoal insulated jacket with multiple utility pockets and reinforced elbows (Akira-brand second season), dark gray cargo pants with thigh holster for data-chip case, scuffed black ankle boots with grip-tread. Layers underneath for temperature regulation. A worn leather cord with a single unmarked data-stick hangs under her collar. Her aesthetic prioritizes function over fashion, but the cuts and materials suggest measured investment — nothing cheap, nothing flashy.
